statement_en: If $E$ is a measurable subset of $\mathbb{R}^{d_1}\times \mathbb{R}^{d_2}$, then for almost every $y \in \mathbb{R}^{d_2}$ the slice $$E^{y}=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^{d_1}:(x,y)\in E\}$$ is measurable, $m(E^{y})$ is a measurable function of $y$, and $$m(E)=\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d_2}}m(E^{y})\,dy.$$ Similarly, for almost every $x \in \mathbb{R}^{d_1}$ the corresponding slices are measurable, the slice measure is measurable as a function of $x$, and $$m(E)=\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d_1}}m(E_{x})\,dx.$$
callout_body:
如果$E$是$\mathbb{R}^{d_1}\times \mathbb{R}^{d_2}$当中的一个可测集合，那么对于几乎每个$y \in \mathbb{R}^{d_2}$都有切片,$$E^{y}=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^{d_1}:(x,y)\in E\}$$
这种切片都是可测的集合，并且$m(E^{y})$是关于$y$的可测函数，并且$$m(E)=\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d_2}}m(E^{y})\,dy$$同样的也有对几乎每个$x \in \mathbb{R}^{d_1}$都有切片,$$E_{x}=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^{d_1}:(x,y)\in E\}$$这种切片都是可测的集合，并且$m(E_{x})$是关于$x$的可测函数，并且$$m(E)=\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d_1}}m(E_{x})\,dx$$
